name: create_todo_task
description: Use this tool to create a todo task. {{ todo_list_names }}
arguments_prompt:
- **Purpose**: Create a new to-do task.
- **Arguments**:
  - `task_name` (str, required): The name/title of the task.
  - `description` (str, optional): Detailed description of the task.
  - `due_date` (str, optional): Deadline for the task in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-31T17:00:00").
  - `priority` (str, optional): Priority level of the task. Allowed values: `"high"`, `"normal"`, `"low"`. Default is `"normal"`.
  - `estimated_time` (float, optional): Estimated time to complete the task in hours.
  - `tasklist_name` (str, optional): Name of the task list to add the task to.

Arguments to this tool are the name of the task, due date string and description string

task_name: str
due_date: str
description: str

[WARNING] Avoid ambiguity at midnight: Times exactly at 00:00:00 can be misinterpreted as either the start or end of a day. When setting boundaries, explicitly choose 23:59:59 (end of the previous day) or 00:01:00 (start of the new day) for clarity.
